ValidationRule.description: This Validation Rule was configured to prevent AM from Rejecting a Quote without selecting reason
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c) , $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(ISCHANGED( PMC_CPQ_FlowVRByPassToggle__c )), ISCHANGED(SBQQ__Status__c), ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Status__c, 'Rejected'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_CPQ_RejectedReason__c , "") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the Rejection Reason before rejecting the quote
